text:
marco: FYI I opened a small docs PR to consolidate examples for tiered usage (SDK + curl) and a trimmed grafana target. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5291

Tess: thanks — can you explicitly show the Authorization header in the curl sample and add a one-line sample response? saves support back-and-forth.

marco: draft snippets below; kept them compact. added the header and a sample response.

```python
# SDK v4: usage breakdown by tier
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.usage.query(
    start="2026-05-01T00:00:00Z",
    end="2026-05-31T23:59:59Z",
    breakdown="tier",
    filters={"product":"embedding-service"}
)
print(resp.metrics)
# sample -> [{"tier":"starter","tokens":12000},{"tier":"pro","tokens":450000}]
```

```bash
# curl equivalent (header shown explicitly)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-05-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-05-31T23:59:59Z","breakdown":"tier","filters":{"product":"embedding-service"}}'
```

leo: tiny grafana target for the docs (title + targets only):

`{"title":"Tokens per tier","targets":[{"expr":"sum by (tier) (redwood_usage_tokens_total{product=\"embedding-service\"})","legendFormat":"{{tier}}"}]}`

sanjay: please add an FAQ bullet: tier credits prorate to the second; billing job rounds at run time. note that reserved capacity credits are applied before on-demand credits for the same account id.

marco: added FAQ blurb and clarified that ephemeral/system tokens are filtered from public usage queries by default.

docs-bot: PR updated: marco pushed 2 commits to docs/metering-tier-examples at 1788604600 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5291/files

qa-bot: smoke check: curl returns 200, SDK snippet executed in clean env, grafana panel renders sample series in staging grafana.

Tess: LGTM. I'll approve and merge once CI finishes. Thanks for keeping examples compact and showing the explicit header.
